dataset.caveat: At W=60 s every model scores ~0.19 test macro-F1 — an information limit of the data (early windows are near-identical across classes), not a model defect. The gate therefore covers W = 120/300/600 s only.
dataset.channels: 88 no-oracle sensor channels served by the twin (the 96-channel oracle setting was also evaluated in the project; the twin serves the no-oracle models)
dataset.metric: test macro-F1, no-oracle (88-channel) setting, from the Task E evaluation (notebook protocol; reproduced exactly by the advanced-modeling addendum)
dataset.source: NPPAD PCTRAN PWR simulations — Task E take-home (Predicting the Boiling Crisis), accident diagnosis, 12 classes
dataset.split: by run, stratified by class and severity — train 725 / validation 242 / test 244 runs

gate.rule: A pull request that changes registry metrics fails the Model validation gate if any production-stage model's test macro-F1 at W=120/300/600 regresses more than tolerance_rel (relative) against models/baselines.json, unless the PR carries the override label.

models.description: Original Task E model: 400 trees on per-window summary features of the 88 no-oracle channels. The twin's default diagnosis model.
models.name: Random Forest
models.served_as: data/run_<CLASS>.json field `proba` — baked at all 60 diagnosis steps
